messages:
jordan: Heads up — we just saw alert-router return 503s to the alert-ingest service and fanout stopped. Multiple customer pages didn't go out. Investigating now.
incident-assist-bot: Detected 503 responses from alert-router (x4 nodes). Automatically suppressed retries after 5xx spike. Suppression window: 15m.
maya: Is this the new header-validation check we rolled yesterday? :thinking_face:
jordan: looks related — logs show `invalid-fanout-signature` on the router side. pulling logs.
ash: (ops) I'm on call but tied up. @talia can you take lead?
talia: taking lead. Quick status: we have 18 min of suppressed fanout, ~6 customers affected (experimental tenants). Manual paging fallback hasn't triggered due to suppression rule.
ash: ugh — suppression was meant to avoid noisy retries, not block all fanout. Can we disable suppression temporarily?
incident-assist-bot: To disable suppression run: `POST /admin/suppression/disable?scope=alert-router` — requires admin token.
jordan: running disable now (using admin-runner). Output: `200 OK` — suppression disabled.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step 3: restart alert-router pod group `router-prod-3` if 5xx persists.
maya: logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-18T09:12:05Z] alert-router-3 ERROR invalid-fanout-signature id=abcd1234 headers={x-sign: ""}
[2026-03-18T09:12:06Z] alert-router-3 ERROR upstream write failed: broken pipe
```
ash: switching to manual escalation: I'm calling the oncall phone tree for the affected tenants and we should send SMS via notify-proxy. @talia please post the manual SMS template in this thread.
talia: SMS template posted and sent to ops-sms relay: "Redwood Inference: Incident — paging delayed for your account. Our ops team is escalating and will follow up." :phone:
jordan: restarted router pod group `router-prod-3` per runbook. Awaiting health checks.
incident-assist-bot: Health checks: router-prod-3 -> ready, cpu 18%, 200 OK to ingest.
maya: fanout resumed for most tenants. I'm watching for error recurrence.
nash: customer impact estimate: 6 tenants had pages suppressed for ~18m; no production SLA hit yet but some on-call queues missed notifications. Manual SMS sent to all 6 tenants and CS notified.
talia: mitigation summary: 1) disabled suppression window, 2) restarted router-prod-3, 3) manual SMS escalation for affected customers, 4) oncall phone tree triggered.
jordan: root cause hypothesis: header-validation change in alert-ingest/ingress produced empty x-sign on some requests; alert-router interpreted as invalid signature and suppression logic treated it as persistent failure.
maya: next actions: revert header-validation patch on staging, add a fail-open for fanout in suppression code, and add an eval to detect suppression blocking pages.
nash: assigned follow-ups: @jordan to open postmortem draft, @maya to prepare rollback PR, @talia to own customer comms thread.
ops-runbook-bot: Post-incident checklist added to incident ticket #INC-5409.
jordan: thanks all — closing live mitigation. We'll keep channel open for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
